ExV01Title.en: ExVerus: Verus proof repair via counterexample reasoning, by Jun Yang, Yuechun Sun and colleagues, at ICML 2026.
ExV01Title.zh: ExVerus：基于 counterexample 推理的 Verus 证明修复。作者是 Jun Yang、孙悦淳等人，发表于 ICML 2026。

ExV02ColdOpen.en: Here is a small Rust function checked by the Verus verifier. It finds the maximum of a vector, and its loop carries invariants: facts that hold on every pass.
ExV02ColdOpen.zh: 这是一个由 Verus verifier 检查的小 Rust 函数。它求一个 vector 的最大值，循环上带着若干 loop invariant：每一轮都成立的事实。

ExV02ColdOpen.en: Verus rejects the last invariant: invariant not satisfied at end of loop body. The message says where the proof broke, but not why.
ExV02ColdOpen.zh: Verus 拒绝了最后一条 invariant：invariant not satisfied at end of loop body。这条消息说明了证明在哪里断掉，却没有说明为什么。

ExV02ColdOpen.en: Verus compiles this proof into a 7,083-line SMT query. The solver answers unknown, and its model says i is 537 and the vector has length 1681, in internal symbols.
ExV02ColdOpen.zh: Verus 把这个证明编译成 7,083 行的 SMT 查询。Solver 的回答是 unknown，它的模型说 i 是 537、vector 长度是 1681，而且用的是内部符号。

ExV02ColdOpen.en: ExVerus gets this instead: nums is minus one, minus one; i is one; max is zero, a value not even in the array.
ExV02ColdOpen.zh: ExVerus 得到的则是：nums 是负一、负一；i 是一；max 是零，这个值甚至不在数组里。

ExV02ColdOpen.en: That is the idea of ExVerus: turn a verifier's one-line error into concrete counterexamples, and use them to repair the proof.
ExV02ColdOpen.zh: 这就是 ExVerus 的核心想法：把 verifier 的一行报错变成具体的 counterexample，再用它们来修复证明。

ExV03Background.en: In Verus you write Rust plus a specification: requires holds on entry, ensures holds on return, and every loop needs invariants.
ExV03Background.zh: 在 Verus 中，你写的是 Rust 加上 specification：requires 在进入时成立，ensures 在返回时成立，每个循环都需要 loop invariant。

ExV03Background.en: An invariant must hold before the loop and survive one iteration. Verus turns each obligation into a verification condition for the SMT solver Z3.
ExV03Background.zh: 一条 invariant 必须在循环前成立，并且撑过一轮迭代。Verus 把每一项义务变成 verification condition，交给 SMT solver Z3。

ExV03Background.en: A counterexample is a state that satisfies the assumptions but breaks the goal. With quantifiers, the solver often gives up instead.
ExV03Background.zh: Counterexample 是一个满足前提、却违反目标的状态。公式里有 quantifier 时，solver 常常直接放弃。

ExV03Background.en: ExVerus has the language model write a small Z3Py query at the source level, with the program's own names. Here it fixes the vector length to two, so no quantifiers are needed.
ExV03Background.zh: ExVerus 让语言模型在源码层面写一个小的 Z3Py 查询，使用程序自己的变量名。这里它把 vector 长度固定为二，于是不再需要 quantifier。

ExV03Background.en: The solver then quickly returns small, readable states. The query may even relax soundness, because nothing it produces is trusted until Verus checks it.
ExV03Background.zh: 这样 solver 就能很快返回小而易读的状态。这个查询甚至可以放松 soundness，因为它产生的任何东西在 Verus 检查之前都不被信任。

ExV04Brs1Bug.en: Now the main example, brs1 from VerusBench. A hidden first loop fills a with ones; the second adds them into sum zero, resetting it only on the first pass.
ExV04Brs1Bug.zh: 现在看主例子，VerusBench 里的 brs1。省略的第一个循环把 a 全部填成一；第二个循环把它们累加到 sum[0]，只在第一轮把它清零。

ExV04Brs1Bug.en: The language model's proof claims, as an invariant of the second loop, that sum zero is at most i.
ExV04Brs1Bug.zh: 语言模型给出的证明，把“sum[0] 不超过 i”作为第二个循环的 invariant。

ExV04Brs1Bug.en: Verus answers: invariant not satisfied before loop. The earlier tool AutoVerus spent 16 attempts on exactly this error and still failed the task.
ExV04Brs1Bug.zh: Verus 的回答是：invariant not satisfied before loop。之前的工具 AutoVerus 在这个错误上尝试了 16 次，最终仍然没能完成这个任务。

ExV05Brs1Cex.en: ExVerus asks the solver for states that break the invariant at loop entry: a is one, one; sum is one; i is zero; N is two. Another has sum equal to two.
ExV05Brs1Cex.zh: ExVerus 向 solver 要在进入循环时违反这条 invariant 的状态：a 是一、一；sum 是一；i 是零；N 是二。另一个状态中 sum 等于二。

ExV05Brs1Cex.en: Plug in the first: sum zero is one, i is zero, and one is not at most zero. At loop entry, sum zero still holds whatever the caller passed in.
ExV05Brs1Cex.zh: 代入第一个：sum[0] 是一，i 是零，而一并不小于等于零。进入循环时，sum[0] 仍是调用者传进来的任意值。

ExV05Brs1Cex.en: But the language model could be wrong. So a validator without any language model extracts the loop, turns the invariants into assertions, and injects the counterexample.
ExV05Brs1Cex.zh: 但语言模型也可能出错。所以一个不涉及语言模型的 validator 把循环抽取出来，把 invariant 变成 assertion，并注入 counterexample。

ExV05Brs1Cex.en: Verus runs it. The last assertion fails, the same symptom as the real error, so this counterexample is validated.
ExV05Brs1Cex.zh: Verus 运行它。最后一条 assertion 失败，和真实错误的症状一致，因此这个 counterexample 通过了验证。

ExV06Triage.en: Next, triage. A counterexample can be reachable by a real run, or spurious: no run ever reaches it.
ExV06Triage.zh: 接下来是 triage。一个 counterexample 可能是 reachable 的，即真实运行能到达；也可能是 spurious 的，即任何运行都到达不了。

ExV06Triage.en: Reachable means the invariant is wrong and must be replaced. Spurious means it may be true but too weak, so it must be strengthened.
ExV06Triage.zh: Reachable 说明 invariant 是错的，必须替换。Spurious 说明它可能是对的但太弱，必须加强。

ExV06Triage.en: For brs1 the verdict is wrong fact: the invariant fails at loop entry when i is zero and sum zero is positive, and those states are reachable.
ExV06Triage.zh: 对 brs1，判定是 wrong_fact：当 i 为零且 sum[0] 为正时，invariant 在进入循环前就不成立，而这些状态是可达的。

ExV06Triage.en: For findmax the verdict went the other way: max equal to zero cannot occur, so the states were spurious and the invariants too weak.
ExV06Triage.zh: 而对 findmax，判定正好相反：max 等于零不可能出现，所以这些状态是 spurious 的，invariant 太弱。

ExV07Repair.en: Guided by the verdict, a replacing mutator proposes candidate proofs, five by default. It targets the pattern the counterexamples share: i is zero and sum zero is positive.
ExV07Repair.zh: 根据这个判定，一个替换型 mutator 提出若干候选证明，默认五个。它针对这些 counterexample 的共同模式：i 为零，sum[0] 为正。

ExV07Repair.en: Candidates are ranked by how many validated counterexamples they block, meaning how many no longer trigger the failure. This ranking is inspired by the model-checking algorithm PDR.
ExV07Repair.zh: 候选证明按照它们 block 了多少个经过验证的 counterexample 来排序，也就是有多少个 counterexample 不再触发失败。这种排序受 model checking 算法 PDR 启发。

ExV07Repair.en: The top candidate, mutant one, guards the invariant: if i is greater than zero, then sum zero is at most i.
ExV07Repair.zh: 排名第一的候选，mutant_1，给 invariant 加上了条件：如果 i 大于零，那么 sum[0] 不超过 i。

ExV07Repair.en: Run the validation harness again with the new invariant: the assertion now passes, so counterexample one is blocked.
ExV07Repair.zh: 用新的 invariant 再运行一次 validation harness：assertion 现在通过了，所以第一个 counterexample 被 block 了。

ExV07Repair.en: Mutant one blocks all the counterexamples and passes Verus, solving the task.
ExV07Repair.zh: mutant_1 block 了所有 counterexample，并通过了 Verus 验证，从而解决了这个任务。

ExV08Architecture.en: Here is the whole method. It starts from the language model's proof and the error Verus reports.
ExV08Architecture.zh: 下面是整个方法。它从语言模型写的证明和 Verus 报告的错误开始。

ExV08Architecture.en: Generate: the model writes a Z3Py query and enumerates counterexamples, ten by default, retrying when the solver does not say SAT.
ExV08Architecture.zh: Generate：模型写出 Z3Py 查询并枚举 counterexample，默认十个；solver 没有返回 SAT 时就重试。

ExV08Architecture.en: Validate: Verus runs each counterexample in the extracted loop; only those that reproduce the error survive. Triage labels the failure wrong fact or too weak.
ExV08Architecture.zh: Validate：Verus 在抽取出的循环里运行每个 counterexample，只有能复现错误的才保留。Triage 把失败归类为 wrong fact 或 too weak。

ExV08Architecture.en: Mutate and rank: five candidates, scored by the counterexamples they block. Verus checks them; if none passes, the loop repeats, up to ten iterations.
ExV08Architecture.zh: Mutate and rank：五个候选，按 block 的 counterexample 数打分。Verus 检查它们；如果都没通过就再走一轮，最多十轮。

ExV08Architecture.en: Follow brs1 through it. The invariant fails before the loop; the solver finds states with i zero and sum positive; Verus confirms they reproduce the error.
ExV08Architecture.zh: 让 brs1 走一遍。Invariant 在循环前失败；solver 找到 i 为零、sum 为正的状态；Verus 确认它们能复现这个错误。

ExV08Architecture.en: Triage says wrong fact; the guarded invariant blocks the counterexamples; and Verus accepts the proof.
ExV08Architecture.zh: Triage 判定为 wrong fact；加了条件的 invariant block 了这些 counterexample；Verus 接受了这个证明。

ExV08Architecture.en: The language model proposes counterexamples, verdicts and repairs, but only Verus decides.
ExV08Architecture.zh: 语言模型负责提出 counterexample、判定和修复，但只有 Verus 做最终决定。

ExV09Results.en: Now the results. Table 1 compares ExVerus with AutoVerus and plain iterative refinement on four benchmarks, here with Claude Sonnet 4.5.
ExV09Results.zh: 接下来看结果。Table 1 在四个 benchmark 上比较 ExVerus、AutoVerus 和简单的 iterative refinement，这里是 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的结果。

ExV09Results.en: ExVerus leads on VerusBench, LCBench and HumanEval, and all three tie on DafnyBench. On the harder LCBench and HumanEval, success stays below one half.
ExV09Results.zh: ExVerus 在 VerusBench、LCBench 和 HumanEval 上领先，三者在 DafnyBench 上打平。在更难的 LCBench 和 HumanEval 上，成功率仍不到一半。

ExV09Results.en: With a weaker model, DeepSeek V3.1, the gap on VerusBench widens: 71.9 percent for ExVerus, 24.7 for AutoVerus, and 60.3 for iterative refinement.
ExV09Results.zh: 换成较弱的模型 DeepSeek V3.1，VerusBench 上的差距变大：ExVerus 是 71.9%，AutoVerus 是 24.7%，iterative refinement 是 60.3%。

ExV09Results.en: On ObfsBench, the same tasks obfuscated six ways, ExVerus with DeepSeek scores 73.9 to 86.5 percent; AutoVerus, 24.7 to 36.5.
ExV09Results.zh: 在 ObfsBench 上，同样的任务用六种方式混淆。使用 DeepSeek 时，ExVerus 的成功率在 73.9% 到 86.5% 之间，AutoVerus 在 24.7% 到 36.5% 之间。

ExV10Evidence.en: Do the counterexamples matter? A variant that hands them straight to the model, without mutators or validation, reaches 65.4 percent on ObfsBench with DeepSeek. Full ExVerus reaches 81.6.
ExV10Evidence.zh: Counterexample 真的有用吗？一个把 counterexample 直接交给模型、不用 mutator 也不做 validation 的变体，在 DeepSeek 和 ObfsBench 上达到 65.4%，完整的 ExVerus 是 81.6%。

ExV10Evidence.en: And blocking predicts success. With one counterexample per repair, 172 of 243 mutants that block it verify, against 38 of 153 mutants that block nothing.
ExV10Evidence.zh: 而且 block 能预测成功。每次修复只用一个 counterexample 时，block 了它的 243 个 mutant 中有 172 个通过验证；而什么都没 block 的 153 个 mutant 中只有 38 个通过。

ExV10Evidence.en: Cost depends on the model. With DeepSeek V3.1, a task costs 4 cents instead of 17 and takes 720 seconds instead of 2989. With GPT-4o, it costs 42 cents against 69.
ExV10Evidence.zh: 成本取决于模型。使用 DeepSeek V3.1 时，每个任务 4 美分而不是 17 美分，耗时 720 秒而不是 2989 秒。使用 GPT-4o 时是 42 美分对 69 美分。

ExV11Limits.en: The paper also states its limits. Counterexample validation covers loop invariant errors; for other errors, the counterexamples are unvalidated hints.
ExV11Limits.zh: 论文也说明了它的局限。Counterexample validation 只覆盖 loop invariant 错误；对其他错误，counterexample 只是未经验证的提示。

ExV11Limits.en: ExVerus is weaker on proofs that need assertions or proof blocks. And passing Verus does not show that the specification matches what the user intended.
ExV11Limits.zh: ExVerus 在需要 assertion 或 proof block 的证明上较弱。而且通过 Verus 并不说明 specification 符合用户的本意。

ExV12Takeaway.en: To sum up: ExVerus makes the counterexample the unit of feedback, and scores every repair by the counterexamples it rules out.
ExV12Takeaway.zh: 总结一下：ExVerus 把 counterexample 当作反馈的基本单位，并用一个修复排除了多少 counterexample 来给它打分。

ExV12Takeaway.en: Instead of a one-line error, the model sees concrete program states. Blocking them turns open-ended proof search into a targeted search, and Verus still has the final word.
ExV12Takeaway.zh: 模型看到的不再是一行报错，而是具体的程序状态。Block 这些状态，把开放式的证明搜索变成有针对性的搜索，而最终的判定仍然由 Verus 做出。
